title: The Penumbra Underways
_note: Lane N3 (walkthrough/11 Part D). The last road under the Penumbra Ring: the Hollowing's last watch keeps its fire here under the Spire's roots. snes register (kept sparse, <=6 voices), C minor, 92 bpm (cave band), 24 bars (A A' B C). Dark signature: a lone faltering pulse lead and long silences; Light signature: a high bell sparkle that takes over when the lead falls silent (C). Vesper motif FRAGMENTED: the lift G3-C4-D4 survives and hangs, the settle fails onto the leading tone B3; B widens the leap toward the Spire's minor boom (Eb5) and still lands on the dominant. A heartbeat bass (lub-dub) and a soft kick like footsteps carry it; the last two bars leave only G under the bells, falling back into the lift.
